tools.name: get_launch_options
tools.description: What a Paid2Call launch can be set to, and whether launches are open right now.

tools.name: quote_first_buy
tools.description: How much of the supply a creator's first buy gets (PUMP pair, 3% fee). Give sol or percent_of_supply.

tools.name: create_launch_draft
tools.description:
Prepare a token launch. Nothing is created on-chain.

    reward_levels: e.g. [{"followers": 100, "reward_usdc": 10}, {"followers": 1000, "reward_usdc": 40}].
    image_base64: the token image itself (PNG, JPEG, WEBP or GIF, square, 1 MB max). Paid2Call never
    downloads images from a URL; image_u

tools.name: get_signing_message
tools.description:
The exact text a wallet must sign (signMessage, UTF-8, base58 signature) before an action.

    action: "launch" (prove you hold the creator wallet; valid 10 minutes),
            "queue" (register a callout for payment; needs mint and callout_id),
            "fomo_bonus" (claim the +20% FOMO bonus

tools.name: prepare_launch_transactions
tools.description:
For an agent that holds its own Solana wallet: build the launch transactions from a draft.

    challenge/signature: from get_signing_message(action="launch") signed by wallet.
    Returns transactions to sign with that wallet (base64, unsigned by you) and submit IN ORDER with
    submit_signed_tran

tools.name: submit_signed_transaction
tools.description:
Relay a launch transaction you signed. Only transactions prepared by Paid2Call in the last 3 minutes are accepted;
    the server adds the token address signature. Waits up to 60 seconds for confirmation by default.

tools.name: get_launch_status
tools.description: After a launch: is the token on-chain and listed on Paid2Call, and where to see it.

tools.name: find_paying_pools
tools.description:
Tokens whose callout pool is open, with what one call pays by follower count.
    sort: balance (most USDC first), new, volume, mcap, paid. A paid callout = buy the minimum, post the call on
    pump.fun mentioning paid2call.com, hold for the hold time, then register_for_payment.

tools.name: get_pool
tools.description: One token's callout pool: rewards, rules, balance, recent payments and whether registration is open.

tools.name: find_my_callouts
tools.description:
The wallet's pump.fun callouts for this token that Paid2Call can see (max 20). Each callout_id can be
    registered with register_for_payment. Only callouts that mention paid2call.com are paid.

tools.name: register_for_payment
tools.description:
Register a callout to be paid from the token's pool. Sign get_signing_message(action="queue") first.
    Payment is made by the platform once purchase, call, followers and hold are verified.

tools.name: get_caller_balance
tools.description: What the platform owes this caller, per token, in USDC, and what can be claimed now.

tools.name: prepare_claim_transaction
tools.description:
For a caller agent with its own wallet: the claim transaction for one token's balance. Sign it with the wallet,
    send it to Solana yourself (the wallet pays a tiny network fee), then call report_claim_sent.
    A human can claim instead at https://paid2call.com/claims.

tools.name: report_claim_sent
tools.description: Tell Paid2Call a claim transaction was sent, so the balance shows it as paying.

tools.name: get_fomo_bonus
tools.description:
The +20% FOMO bonus for this token: the wallet's personal code to put in a FOMO thesis with paid2call.com,
    the theses seen, and the bonus amount. Only after a confirmed pump.fun reward.

tools.name: register_fomo_bonus
tools.description: Link a FOMO thesis to the wallet for the +20% bonus. Sign get_signing_message(action="fomo_bonus") first.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_signing_message, find_paying_pools · Private data: create_launch_draft, get_signing_message, prepare_launch_transactions, submit_signed_transaction, get_launch_status, find_paying_pools, get_pool, find_my_callouts, register_for_payment, get_caller_balance, prepare_claim_transaction, get_fomo_bonus, register_fomo_bonus · Public sink: prepare_launch_transactions, submit_signed_transaction, find_paying_pools, prepare_claim_transaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_signing_message, find_paying_pools · Private data: create_launch_draft, get_signing_message, prepare_launch_transactions, submit_signed_transaction, get_launch_status, find_paying_pools, get_pool, find_my_callouts, register_for_payment, get_caller_balance, prepare_claim_transaction, get_fomo_bonus, register_fomo_bonus · Public sink: prepare_launch_transactions, submit_signed_transaction, find_paying_pools, prepare_claim_transaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
